description: A fictional long twin-rail game rifle prop for a mining scout, chunky low-poly, held level with the square muzzle block forward. The front half is two long thick flat dark steel rails, one stacked above the other, with a wide dark gap between them as tall as one rail, in which a recessed dark charcoal web plate runs set back in the middle, so the gap reads as a deep dark slot; at the tip both rails end in one thick square dark steel muzzle block with wide chamfers and one round dark bore opening in its front face. The rear half is a long slim muted olive painted housing block with wide chamfers; around its front end exactly three fat raised dark steel coil rings. On top of the housing one thick charcoal scope tube with a big square front end cap holding a teal-black lens and a big rear end cap, one fat round charcoal knob on top of the tube, standing on two fat blocky charcoal mounts. Under the housing one fat boxy charcoal cell pack ahead of a chunky charcoal pistol grip with a few big diagonal ribs and a squared charcoal trigger guard. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the housing above the cell pack. Behind the housing a flat-sided olive shoulder stock rising to a tall rear end with a thick charcoal butt pad.
proportions: About 1.15 m long, 0.09 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 12.78 : 1 : 3.33)
sides: only the teal lamp window is on one flank: it sits on the LEFT flank of the housing above the cell pack; the right flank is plain olive housing and stock panels with no lamp. The rails, the muzzle block with its bore, the three coil rings, the scope with its knob and mounts, the cell pack, the grip, the trigger guard, the stock and the butt pad are all on the centre line (symmetric left to right).
